the development of creative thinking in children of the Ecuadorian pre-school education through the use of visual arts.
the development of creative thinking in children from the age of three to six years old.
the development of creative thinking and the use of visual arts as a tool for this development in children from 5-6 years old.

the creative development of the child is a fundamental process that should be promoted from the first years of life, through the use of art, in order to achieve a more comprehensive development of the person.

, the use of art as a means to develop the creative thinking of children in early education in Ecuador, is a fundamental tool for the development of the cognitive, social and emotional skills, and for the development of their own personality.

the creative development of children is a process that can be achieved through art, which is an important part of their development.

the visual arts can help develop creative thinking in children.
